files.title: Ptolemy Philadelphus in the Library of Alexandria
files.author: Vincenzo Camuccini, 1813
files.note: An imagined scene painted two thousand years later; labelled on screen PAINTED 1813 · IMAGINED SCENE. Downloaded as the 1920 px Commons rendering; mild saturation/contrast lift.

files.title: Wall mosaic with a Roman ship, depicting the port and the great Pharos (lighthouse) of Alexandria
files.author: Photo: Chappsnet (Stephen Chappell), 2022; Roman mosaic found in Rome in 1876
files.note: Credit required and shown on screen. Changes: bottom 4.5% cropped (photographer's caption strip), resized. The mosaic is Roman-era, later than the Ptolemies; it is used as an ancient picture of a ship at Alexandria's port, not of the seizure.

files.title: Papyrus Oxyrhynchus 1369 (Bridwell Papyrus 4), Sophocles, Oedipus the King, recto
files.author: Unknown ancient scribe; image from Papyri at Bridwell Library
files.note: A later copy of Sophocles found at Oxyrhynchus, not the Athenian original; labelled LATER COPY. Lightly cropped.

files.title: The Great Library of Alexandria (Ancientlibraryalex.jpg)
files.author: O. von Corven, 19th century
files.note: Imagined reconstruction; labelled ENGRAVING, 19TH C. · IMAGINED. Upscaled from 1072 px.

files.title: Galen's group, Vienna Dioscurides, fol. 3 verso
files.author: Unknown illuminator, Constantinople, c. 512
files.note: Galen is the top-centre figure (circled). A portrait made about 300 years after his death; label gives the manuscript date. Cropped to the miniature.
